title: A Multimodal Engineering GraphRAG Framework for Post-Wind-Event Building Assessment and Recovery Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.28216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-event building assessment requires linking observed physical damage to its consequences for safety, habitability, functionality, and recovery. Yet post-disaster evidence is often heterogeneous, incomplete, and distributed across images and reconnaissance reports, while recovery models typically require structured engineering inputs. This study develops a multimodal engineering Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework that connects post-wind-event damage evidence to physical consequences, building-condition states, recovery actions, and downtime. Image- and text-based evidence is transformed into a provenance-preserving, component-level representation distinguishing confirmed damage, explicit negative evidence, unresolved conditions, and temporary measures. translated_title: 一种用于风灾后建筑评估与恢复推理的多模态工程GraphRAG框架
translated_abstract: 事件后的建筑评估需要将观察到的物理损伤与其对安全性、可居住性、功能性和恢复方面的影响联系起来。然而，灾后证据往往是异构的、不完整的，并且分散在图像和踏勘报告之中，而恢复模型通常需要结构化的工程输入。本研究开发了一种多模态工程图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）框架，将风灾后的损伤证据与物理后果、建筑状态、恢复行动以及停用时间联系起来。基于图像和文本的证据被转化为一种保留来源信息的组件级表示，能够区分已确认的损伤、明确的负面证据、未解决的状况和临时措施。图对齐检索将可比的建筑场景与明确的工程关系相结合，同时利用兼容性、矛盾性、证据优先级等机制……
tldr: 该研究提出了一种多模态工程GraphRAG框架，将风灾后分散的图像与文本损伤证据转化为保留来源的组件级表示，并将其与物理后果、建筑状态、恢复行动和停用时间相关联，从而支持灾后建筑评估与恢复推理。
en_tdlr: This study develops a multimodal engineering GraphRAG framework that transforms heterogeneous post-wind-event image and text damage evidence into provenance-preserving, component-level representations and links them to physical consequences, building-condition states, recovery actions, and downtime, enabling post-event building assessment and recovery inference.
